ana: quick brain dump from pairing: propose a lightweight manifest extension to enable cross-mirror dedupe without forcing identical ciphertext everywhere. idea: publish cipher_fingerprint + model_fingerprint + an optional shard-bloom (64-byte base64) that represents chunk membership for cheap negative checks.

dave: Bloom sounds cool for early-rejects. what's the bloom built over—chunk hashes or fixed-size chunk positions?

ana: chunk hashes (e.g., blake3 of 64k chunks) so bloom says "this shard likely contains chunk X". loader can avoid origin attempts if target chunk not in bloom. small false positive rate ok.

lina: ops concern: different encryption IVs per upload will change ciphertext; so cipher_fingerprint won't match. bloom over chunk hashes can be computed on plaintext and then encrypted, but to use bloom pre-decrypt you'd need a bloom over ciphertext-chunk-hashes which defeats plaintext dedupe. tradeoff.

ana: right. tradeoff summary: - cipher_fingerprint allows true zero-copy dedupe but requires identical ciphertexts - model_fingerprint (plaintext) gives logical dedupe but requires decrypt-before-verify - chunk-bloom can be used opportunistically once model_hash known or if repo exposes plaintext-bloom to trusted regions.

dave: implementation notes: manifest fields: cipher_fingerprint, model_fingerprint, chunk_count, chunk_size, chunk_bloom(base64), per-chunk checksums (optional). loader logic: try fetch_by_cipher first; if none, fetch and stream-decrypt while verifying model_fingerprint if loader has keys. if loader lacks keys, fallback to full download + handoff to decrypting node.

lina: security/policy: exposing plaintext-based bloom or chunk list in public mirrors might leak model structure. add a flag in manifest: bloom_visibility: "public" | "private". private blooms only returned to authenticated regions.

ana: perf estimate: bloom (64B) reduces origin probes by ~20% in our sim for mirrored popular models. overhead tiny.

infra-bot: ticket INF-8111 created: shard-manifest-bloom-and-fingerprints. linked to RFC-482.

dave: tests: bloom_false_positive_behavior, cipher_mismatch_fallback, private_bloom_access_control, stream-decrypt-verify-memory-leak. add telemetry: bloom_skip_count, cipher_dedupe_count, decrypt_then_verify_count, origin_probe_retries.

lina: rollout: additive manifest fields -> registry stores but loader ignores unknown fields -> opt-in canary with bloom-aware logic -> enable private_bloom for internal mirrors first.

ana: owners: ana (manifest + perf sims), dave (loader + stream-decrypt helpers), lina (security + policy). i'll draft RFC appendix with bloom params and canonical chunking rules. closing thread.

dave: +1

lina: +1 :shipit:
